t: This is the St. Pancras Renaissance hotel, part of the main building at St Pancras railway station, where the Eurostar trains arrive from Paris, Brussels and Amsterdam. It occupies much of the former Midland Grand Hotel, which opened in 1873 and closed in 1935. The hotel you see reopened in 2011 and is managed by Marriott. The original building was designed by George Gilbert Scott, a prolific Gothic Revival architect who designed or altered over 800 buildings, mostly churches and cathedrals.
